displayDescription: Distressed IDEA ink surfaces, a rough dashed network wires out from a rust dot, and a torn SYSTEM paste-up lands on cold xerox stock.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (precomputed paper grain, ink textures, distress masks, local threshold reveals)
Rough.js 4.6.6 (seeded rough linework: links, X nodes, origin dot, stains, tape, plate)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (single owner of composition time; Canvas redrawn as a pure function of timeline time, plus hf-seek redraw)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track, music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Blender was not used, per user instruction; the scene is built in Canvas 2D and Rough.js.
Paper grain, toner dropout, scratches and stains are seeded procedural approximations, not scanned photocopy or real paper textures.
The torn plate edge and wipe are 2D clip approximations. There is no physical paper simulation.
BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json listed no matched sources or contact sheets, so the cool xerox-grey background is an authored scene-dependent choice, not one taken from source frames.
Display type depends on locally installed Impact/Courier New, with system fallbacks.
No preview_recipes are defined in STYLE.json, so the preview shows the primary Grunge technique.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; host QA is pending.
